stage: BEFORE_DR_ELIGIBILITY_COUNTS; schema and metadata column decoding only inspected
same_population: All retained primary windows across both contexts and both halves must be contained in each counted unit's provider obs_intervals. Use one single probe, never context-specific unit sets.
observation_interval_validation: Finite ordered start<stop pairs; sorted nonoverlapping intervals; empty/missing/malformed intervals are unknown and do not pass. Each [stim_start,stim_start+0.5] must lie in one supplied observation interval. Do not infer support from spike endpoints.
anatomy_gate: Provider target structure plus finite ccf_ap/ccf_dv/ccf_ml for qualified units. Raw structural counts and exclusions for missing coordinates remain separate.
quality_gate: Provider is_qc_pass=True; is_not_drift is reported, not a newly tuned cutoff. This is not training-only physiological admission.
source_compatibility: Catalog/session/trial/unit subject and session identities must match exactly for a qualified population. Missing cached sessions or mismatches are explicit unknown/exclusions, not invented observations or automatically imported other releases.
selection: Most qualified same-probe units, then greatest minimum context-half trial count, then lexical session_id/probe. No scores, fitting or actual allocation.
